# Failure lines the ledger must resolve, pinned verbatim.
#
# Format: `group<TAB>logger<TAB>message`. `#` lines are comments.
#
# Provenance, group by group, because which of these are recovered verbatim and
# which are written in a recorded shape is the difference between a fixture that
# measures something and one that asserts its own contents:
#
# `hypothesis-echo-truncation` and `hypothesis-schema-invalid` are the two error
# lines #446 and #489 counted over the 192 dumps in `_pipeline/research/_debug/`
# — `Unterminated string starting at: line 6 column 16/18` x178 and
# `overlay_files missing/empty` x6. The dumps are gone (the retention sweep
# prunes that scratch after 30 days; the directory held exactly 1 file at triage)
# so the two lines are pinned here rather than read from the corpus, and the pair
# must resolve to TWO signatures — one signature would mean the normalizer is
# over-collapsing and the two root causes #446 and #489 split by hand would be
# merged back into the blob that made the item necessary.
#
# `hypothesis-contract-anchor` is verbatim from the one surviving dump,
# `_pipeline/research/_debug/hypothesis_reject_2026-09-26T05-14-27Z_v3.txt`, the
# first line after the `=== ERROR ===` header. It is here so the file is not all
# reconstruction.
#
# `fetch-crashed` is the pair #611 named: `fetch crashed: --fetch rc=2` on two
# distinct video ids, `pAnLpiAG6Es` and `50IgNjRtwNE`, the 84 `runs` rows from
# 2026-09-09 that the sweep has since pruned (`workers.db` holds exactly 1
# `fetch crashed` row today, run_youtube-digest_20260930_150852_2fb1ce, an
# `rc=-15` shape). Written here in the shape #611 recorded — the id appears only
# inside the `youtu.be/<id>` URL in the crash text, not as a bare token — which
# is the shape that collapses: `_PATH` eats `/youtu.be/<id>`. A bare id does NOT
# collapse, and that gap is recorded on #2079 rather than patched into the
# guardian's normalizer.
